epub-template-server 1.0.0

- Initial release of the intelligent template search assistant for epub360.
- Enables AI-powered search for epub360 templates via API.
- Requires user to provide an API key for all operations; prompts if missing.
- Includes a workflow for intent understanding, parameter extraction, and tool choosing.
- Supports keyword-based template search with customizable result limits.
- Prohibits any data generation or search without a valid API key.
